name: tgcli
description: The tgcli skill, and a session-start check that tells the agent when tg is missing or not logged in.

interface.shortDescription: Read, search and answer your own Telegram
interface.longDescription: Your agent reads, searches and downloads from your own Telegram account through the tg command. Nothing is sent, edited or deleted until you approve the exact text.
